variables.name: notes
describe: abc followed by a space, repeated 80 times, trailing spaces trimmed

rules: weight_kg row 4 is system-missing (SPSS SYSMIS): an empty cell with missing reason blank.
elisa 9 and age_months -99 are user-missing: the import proposes them as missing codes and asks the reason (G26), as it does for CSV codes.
notes is a very long string (record 7.14): 900 bytes in segments of 255, joined before decoding; trailing spaces are padding and are removed.
vaccinated_in_last_six_months is longer than 8 characters: the short name in record 2 is replaced by the long name from record 7.13.
sampled is seconds since 1582-10-14 in the file; DATE11 marks it as a date, read as days since 1970-01-01 (subtract 12219379200 seconds, divide by 86400).
